title: Lesson 19 - Data consistency: validation rules, required fields, picklists, unique constraints, lookup filters, duplicate rules, external IDs
description: Given a customer scenario, recommend techniques to ensure data is persisted in a consistent manner, including validation rules, required fields, dependent picklists, unique constraints, lookup filters, duplicate rules, and external IDs.

questions.question: Data loaded via Data Loader is creating Accounts missing an industry, even though the field is marked required on the page layout. What is the fix?
options: Make the field required at the field level (or add a validation rule)
questions.explanation: Layout-required fields are UI-only; field-level required or a validation rule enforces the value across API/Data Loader paths.

questions.question: Which TWO mechanisms preserve referential integrity on a lookup relationship?
options: Lookup filters restricting eligible parent records
A dependent picklist on the lookup field
Master-detail relationship with cascade behavior and/or required lookup
A page layout with the field marked read-only
questions.explanation: Lookup filters limit eligible parents (A) and master-detail/required lookups enforce the relationship's existence and delete behavior (C); dependent picklists constrain values, not relationships (B), and read-only layouts are UI-only (D).

questions.question: An integration upserts records keyed on an external system's ID. Which combination gives the strongest identity protection?
options: A text field with a duplicate rule only
A unique external ID plus a duplicate rule for fuzzy cases
A validation rule checking field length
A lookup filter on the record owner
questions.explanation: A unique external ID enforces the deterministic key and a duplicate rule catches fuzzy duplicates; text-with-rule-only (A) lacks a hard key, and the others do not establish identity.
